_source: Division and group corrections derived from the live Xero P&L (FY26, accrual) and May 2026 sales invoice line descriptions, pulled 2026-09-15. accounts.json stays as the raw Xero-derived mapping; every change is listed here with its evidence so it can be audited or reversed.

Ad Hoc Service Labour.why: Invoice code 42300, Deloitte: 'Labour', 'Engineering Services'. Onsite service work. Confirmed by the user.

Conference Call Charge.why: Billed under managed support contracts. User's call. Nil in May, $215,070 for FY26, so it bills in lumps.

Contract Help Desk.why: Help desk is onsite support. Nil in FY26.

Contract Maintenance.why: Contracted maintenance sits with the onsite support division.

Contract Support Staff.why: Invoice code 41100, all Deloitte: 'Technician - SYD L2', 'Technician - 1st/2nd Level MEL', 'Technician - BNE', 'Technician - ADL', 'Technician - NSTL'. Embedded onsite support technicians by capital city. Pairs with Direct Salaries/Wages/Super - ONS of $1,572,957.

Equipment - Hires.why: Cost side of Equipment Hires. Invoice code 42500 shows 'Audio', 'Lighting', 'Video', 'IT' hire lines.

Equipment -Maintenance Support.why: Maintenance of hire equipment. Nil in FY26.

Equipment Hires.why: Equipment hire revenue. Invoice code 42500 bills 'Audio', 'Lighting', 'Video', 'IT' hire lines for events. Its cost side (Equipment - Hires) is also Production, so both must move together.

Equipment Sales.why: AV hardware supply. Invoice code 42600: 'Commbox CB', 'Motherboard Assembly', 'Miscellaneous Equipment'. Its cost side (Equipment - Purchase) is also Production.

Production Labour.why: Name matches the division. Invoice code 42100 shows 'Bump in', 'Bump out', 'Technical Director' - live event staging.

Tech Consulting/Project Manage.why: Invoice code 42800: 'Phase 2 - Briefing', 'Phase 4 - Tender Support', 'Project Management'.

Installation Labour.why: Installation work is the Integration division.

Instant Asset Write Off.why: $71,153 in FY26 sitting in operating expenses. It is a capital write-off, so it was understating EBITDA by that amount.

Depreciation.why: Belongs below EBITDA. Nil in FY26 - worth asking why.

Depreciation - ROU.why: Right-of-use asset depreciation belongs below EBITDA.

Interest Expense.why: Finance cost, not an operating expense.

Income Tax Expense.why: Tax belongs below net profit before tax.

Under/(Over) provision for tax.why: Prior year tax true-up belongs with tax.

Dividend paid [93000].why: A dividend is a distribution of profit, not an expense. Nil in FY26, but it would have understated net profit directly if used.

unchanged_and_why.Subscriptions & Licences - Income / Expe: Income $241,326 against expense $209,972 - a 13% margin pass-through of third-party licences (invoices show 'Spotify Music Subscription', 'Enterprise Desk Subscription - Cloud'). Putting a pass-through inside one division would drag its margin down misleadingly. Left unallocated.
unchanged_and_why.Opening / Closing Work in Progress: Spans divisions by nature. Left unallocated.
unchanged_and_why.All Other Income: Interest Received, Income Other, grants and subsidies are company-level, not divisional. Correctly unallocated.
unchanged_and_why.Realised / Unrealised Currency Gains, Fo: All nil in FY26. Named as gains but sitting in the Expenses group with sign +1, so a gain would reduce profit. Flagged, not moved - needs a decision on whether each is a gain or a loss account.
